rho_status: Analyst-selected latent Gaussian correlation; not estimated from the supplied study.
right_scores: Standard-normal quantiles at midpoint ranks (i + 0.5) / m.
left_assignment: Rank rho * right_score + sqrt(1 - rho**2) * independent standard-normal noise; assign the sorted left array by those ranks.
between_person_randomness: Independent normal innovations within and across cells, conditional on the supplied marginal grids.
measurement_level: Anatomical-hand mean of three trials, in kg.
